name: @papercupai/notion-export
description: Export the harness's mission summary to a Notion database. Demonstrates secrets:read + http:fetch on the Notion API.
author: Papercusp

title.description: Page title. Defaults to the mission ID.

summary.description: Body content. Markdown is converted client-side.

databaseId.description: Notion database UUID (the parent destination for new pages).

version.description: Notion-Version header. Update if Notion bumps the API.

hiddenReason: Not ready yet — outbound integration is functional against a mock; live wiring against real Jira/Linear/Notion/Slack tenants is not yet verified. Hidden from marketplace until v1.0.
